=== HIGH-PRIORITY WATCHLIST & SHORTLIST (Check in Meantime) ===
1. [Robert Greene & Andrew Huberman]: Access the Sublime & Live Your Best Life (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y-fRFiTrrg4)
   - Deep psychological masterclass on emotional detachment in conflict, quieting anxious DMN rumination, and navigating the 20s/30s Apprentice Phase.
2. [Dr. K (HealthyGamerGG)]: 100 Devs Biggest Problem (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VmmNgeO-Luo)
   - Bridges software engineering cognitive isolation with real-world social presence and boundary defense.
3. [Dr. K]: Is Your Depression Just Laziness? (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8vETGN8awJw)
   - Resolves executive dysfunction, dopamine depletion, and the fear of failure behind task paralysis.
4. [Dr. Mike Israetel]: 30,000 Lifters Hypertrophy Meta-Analysis (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JT6PZdl3_k4)
   - 10-18 weekly hard working sets (RIR 1-3) produces 100% of gains. Kills 25-set junk volume.
5. [Dr. Mike Israetel]: Sleep Deprivation & Muscle Proteolysis (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A3NGVvKBOyk)
   - 5.5h vs 8.5h sleep results in 60% less fat loss and 80% more muscle tissue destroyed.
6. [Michael Feldstein on Modern Wisdom]: Air Quality & Sleep Latency (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2LULm7kcEH0)
   - Bedroom CO2 > 1,000 ppm causes morning brain fog and broken REM sleep. Cracked door/window fix.

=== STUDY NOTE: WHAT MAKES A HIGH ACHIEVER OF ANY GOAL (The 6 Pillars) ===
1. Identity-First Execution: Writing self-concept on paper (present tense) to eliminate decision fatigue.
2. Implementation Intentions (Gollwitzer): Replacing vague motivation with 'When [Trigger], Then [Action]'.
3. Low-Friction Cognitive Scaffolding: Removing the phone from the room (+15% working memory), single-tasking.
4. Non-Moralized Biological Friction: Viewing hesitation as dopamine debt/cortisol, not a moral failure; starting with 120-second micro-actions.
5. Energy & Circadian Management: Respecting the 4-5 hour daily deep-work ceiling; timing hardest CEN load to biological peak.
6. Dispassionate Error Auditing: Removing personal ego from failure; treating dead-ends as experimental data points.

decisions.text: Anchor all performance content on the 'Ultra-Achiever Architecture': Identity on paper, If-Then situation plans, circadian alignment, and non-moralized friction tolerance.
